page.overview:
What is Invincible (TV series)?

Adventure Drama Comedy Sci-fi Superhero Thriller

Simon Racioppa Seth Rogen Evan Goldberg Catherine Winder Cory Walker David Alpert

[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_MGM_Studios Amazon MGM Studios]

Invincible is an American adult animated superhero television series on [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Prime_Video Amazon Prime Video]. The series is based on the Skybound/[https://imagecomics.com/ Image Comics] series of the [https://imagecomics.com/comics/series/invincible same name] by Robert Kirkman, Cory Walker, and Ryan Ottley. Invincible premiered on Amazon Prime Video on March 25, 2021 and rated TV-MA.

Also known as: Invincible show, Invincible animated series.
